name: Sangeki no Yakata ~San Shimai Sanka~
source:
Picnic in the mountains is interrupted by the sudden rain. Something jumps before the car, and hitting the breaks moves the car to the mountainside. Young people find an old mansion and stay there overnight. But they don't know that host prepares a humiliation feast for them.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/11/vn-of-month-november-2005-sharin-no.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
山上的野餐被突如其来的雨打断了。有东西在车前跳跃，撞上刹车，车就移到了山腰上。年轻人找到一座古老的宅邸并在那里过夜。但他们不知道，主人为他们准备了一场羞辱盛宴。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/11/vn-of-month-november-2005-sharin-no.html]vndbreview[/url]]
